dataset.title: A list of the terrestrial and marine biota from the Azores

notes: The archive was handled as opaque bytes only during Gate 1.

The first workflow attempt failed because the GBIF publisher field was assumed to be embedded directly in the dataset JSON; the second failed because the licence API value was a Creative Commons URL rather than the expected shorthand. Both were transport/schema normalization fixes and did not change the frozen dataset identity or inspect archive content.
No downstream node, climate, world-universe or outcome rule is frozen by this manifest.
